title: Carriers of recessive disease are a mild form of the same disease – code and data
description: Analysis code, pre-specification documents, supplemental tables, figures and input documentation (sources and SHA-256 checksums) for the paper 'Carriers of recessive disease are a mild form of the same disease' by Alexander Zentgraf, the Genes & Health Research Team and Christian T. Thiel. All analyses use public summary statistics (UK Biobank via Genebass and the AstraZeneca PheWAS portal, Genes & Health, FinnGen, BioBank Japan, FinMetSeq, exome-chip consortia) and public resources; no individual-level data were used.
